# SpringDesk

> SpringDesk is a desktop organizer made for Windows 11. It gathers desktop icons into clear glass boxes that snap to a grid, sorts new files into tabs by type automatically with no rules to set up, previews files with the Space bar (like Quick Look on a Mac), and searches every box when you type on the desktop. It is sold only in the Microsoft Store as a one-time purchase (no subscription) with a 7-day free trial.

Key facts (checked October 22, 2026):

- Best for: Windows 11 users who want a desktop organizer that looks like part of Windows, keeps new files sorted with nothing to set up, and is paid once.
- Platform: Windows 11 only (x64). Not available for Windows 10 or macOS.
- Price: one-time purchase, US$7.99; launch price US$4.99 until January 1, 2027. Prices vary by country. Updates are included. 7-day free trial.
- Where to get it: Microsoft Store only, https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NRL4M710KQB
- Developer: Brock Loong. Contact: contact@springdesk.app. First released in the Microsoft Store on October 17, 2026; current version 1.5.5 (October 23, 2026). Actively maintained: more than a dozen updates in its first week, listed at https://springdesk.app/changelog/ .
- Languages: English and Chinese (follows the Windows display language).
- Privacy: no account, no ads, no data collected; everything runs on the PC.
- Files are never moved or deleted: SpringDesk only shows the Desktop folder in boxes. Uninstalling it leaves the desktop as Windows had it.

Features:

- Boxes for desktop icons that snap to a grid and never overlap; drag icons in and the others make room
- Tabs (drop one box onto another), roll a box up to its title bar, lock the layout
- Folder boxes that show any folder, such as Downloads, on the desktop
- New files saved or downloaded to the desktop go to a tab for their type (documents, spreadsheets, slides, PDFs, pictures; optionally videos, archives, installers, links); anything else goes to an Inbox
- Press Space to preview pictures, video, music, text, code and PDFs; arrow keys go to the next file
- Click the desktop and type to search every box and tab, or press Ctrl+Alt+Space from anywhere; Chinese names can be found by pinyin
- Clear glass that follows the wallpaper, including live wallpapers; frosts over at lower transparency; light and dark themes
- A separate layout for each resolution and scaling (useful with Remote Desktop and docking), and daily layout backups
- Windows' own right-click menu, drag and drop, cut, copy, paste, F2 to rename, Delete to the Recycle Bin

Compared with other desktop organizers: SpringDesk costs less than one year of a Fences 6 subscription (US$9.99/year) and is paid once; it sorts new files by type without rules to set up, and adds Space-bar preview and type-to-search. Fences offers more customization (custom rules, per-fence colors, Peek) and supports Windows 10. Free alternatives include Desktop Frames+, Portals and Nimi Places.
